children: According to Wallstreetcn, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said at a regular press briefing on the 10th that leaders’ diplomacy has an irreplaceable strategic guiding role in China-U.S. relations, and the two sides have maintained communication on arrangements for leaders’ interactions this year.

title: China Says Leaders’ Diplomacy Has Irreplaceable Strategic Role in U.S.-China Ties
